outputs.explanation: This is a spatial tissue image with cluster color overlays, not a plot of averaged data (micrograph/spatial image), so the individual-data-points check does not apply.
H&E histology images with manual region annotations; not a plot showing averages.

H&E image and spatial gene-expression overlay plots (per-spot color intensity maps on tissue); these are spatial heatmap-style visualizations of raw per-spot expression, not summary/average bar or point plots, so individual points are not applicable.
GSEA enrichment plots are line plots; line plots are exempt from the individual-data-points requirement.

Bar chart shows log2 fold-change values (a single computed statistic per gene from differential expression analysis with associated p-values), not a mean of multiple replicate measurements with variance, so overlaying individual data points is not applicable.
